class: Running a branch's migration (replay) tests against a database shared with other checkouts applies the branch's unmerged migration and can leave the shared database at a different revision than main - every other checkout's local DB tests then run against a schema they do not have.
mechanism: atool.py --no-tests runs every tests_app file that touches alembic/_migration_replay through db_run.py when the branch changes a migration. W-017 added 0015 with a downgrade that raised; the replay tests (downgrade to base, upgrade head) stopped midway and left the shared ofo_test database at 0013 while main's head was 0014.

first_seen.where: GC-2b item 4, W-017 (branch build/W-017-allowlist), local CI mirror
first_seen.evidence: atool: 'migration tests (14 files) rc 1 | 0015_audit_broker_allowlist.py:86: RuntimeError / 6 failed, 894 passed in 2128.45s'; then `alembic current` on ofo_test -> '0013_exchange_freeze_limits' (main head 0014); restored with `alembic upgrade head` from main -> '0014_charge_rates_caps (head)'

fix: Mechanism (GC-2c docs batch, after the 2nd occurrence): atool.py's migration-tests step is followed, always (try/finally), by restore_main_head: read main's head from the main checkout, `alembic downgrade <main head>` from the branch checkout (which knows the newer revision), then `alembic current` from the main checkout must equal main's head or the step is red with both revisions named. Unit-tested with a fake runner (tests/orchestrator/test_atool_restore.py). Brief rule meanwhile: DB commands through the main checkout's db_run.py with the worktree as cwd, ending with `alembic current` read from the main checkout; never copy .env into a worktree. Throwaway-database replay stays an open option.

checks: scripts/orchestrator/atool.py restore_main_head (red when the shared DB is left off main's head)
detection.note: Guards runs that go through atool. A builder running alembic by hand can still move the DB; briefs require the closing `alembic current` from the main checkout.

occurrences.evidence: shared ofo_test left at 0013; restored to 0014

occurrences.where: GC-2c W-094 (migration 0016_execution_plans), the builder's atool.py --no-tests run
occurrences.evidence: the builder reported `alembic current` 0015 after its own downgrade, then its atool run (still going after 20 min, route + migration tests over the tunnel) upgraded the shared DB again; orchestrator read `FAILED: Can't locate revision identified by '0016_execution_plans'` from the main checkout at ~06:50 IST, stopped the run by PID (15024, 19184, 20916) and downgraded from the branch checkout -> '0015_audit_broker_allowlist (head)'

occurrences.where: GC-2c, two DB runs started by the orchestrator side by side (W-094 store tests from one checkout, W-095 round 4's core test from a builder) at ~07:45 IST
occurrences.evidence: each run upgraded/downgraded the shared DB with its own copy of 0016 (one with, one without the tradingsymbol column) while the other's tests ran: W-094's run -> '15 failed, 93 passed' (noise), the builder saw 'an older version of 0016'. Re-run strictly one checkout at a time. Third shape of the class: not a branch-vs-main gap but two branches at once. Rule applied for the rest of GC-2c: one DB holder at a time, named in the brief ('your DB run is the last step; another run may hold the DB').

occurrences.where: builder scope run 1, W-122 (migration 0019_strategy_tracking, insert-only tables), builder ran alembic and its DB tests by hand (not through atool)
occurrences.evidence: the builder's closing `alembic downgrade 0018_basket_tag_8` answered 'refusing downgrade: public.strategy_tracking holds paper entries'; `alembic current` -> '0019_strategy_tracking (head)' while main's head was 0018. Fourth shape: the branch's own tests COMMITTED rows into insert-only tables (no rollback), so the restoring downgrade itself refuses - restore_main_head would also go red here. The same evening tests_app/test_execute_drift_block.py failed 8/8 on main, origin/main and the W-121 branch with 'Catalogue update refused: would drop 207 of 208 live NIFTY contracts' (shared catalogue state left by earlier runs) - shared ofo_test state again. Status stays guarded only for atool runs; DB tests that commit into insert-only tables are unguarded: fix = such tests run inside a rolled-back transaction or a per-run throwaway schema.
